Independent non-author acceptance receipt for couped-parttime-nag.

Reviewed commit 929425bd313448c54a08ec998c5e473690bfd5e9 against parent 360d504f5ceb2e80148084bf6aa5a20589984200. The reviewer did not author the patch.

Stage 1 — Spec Compliance: PASS. All four acceptance criteria map to evidence: exactly six declared paths changed; comment-only projection and parsed YAML equality prove workflow data, embedded shell, expressions, and behavior are unchanged; exact directive text and attachment passed; all 56 edited standalone-comment blocks have immutable before/final citations and strictly shrink.
Architecture Compliance: PASS. The comments-only change preserves the workflow architecture and operational constraints documented by AGENTS.md and docs/architecture.md.
Stage 2 — Code Quality: PASS. The replacement prose is materially shorter, current, consumer-oriented, and free of implementation changes or over-building.
Stage 3 — Domain Integrity: PASS / not applicable to domain types. No executable code, identifiers, validation, state representation, or domain boundary changed.
Overall: APPROVED. Required changes: 0. Blocking findings: 0.

Independent validation: parsed workflow-data equality PASS; physical comment/blank-only diff PASS; exact shellcheck/zizmor/predates-gate-ok/mechanism-ok text and next-code attachment PASS; exact six-path census PASS; comment hygiene and diff integrity PASS; focused suites 24 + 78 + 25 + 170 = 297 passed with 3 expected skips; worktree-venv make lint PASS; rebar verify-commit-ticket PASS. Full make verify intentionally omitted under the operator comments-only CI substitution; Gerrit Verified remains required before landing.

Tracker transport note: authenticated MCP reads remained available, but both log_session and comment_ticket writes returned Auth required. This receipt therefore used the documented local rebar fallback.

Word census strips each standalone comment prefix and whitespace-splits. Total 5470 -> 2090 (3380 removed); every row is strictly shorter.
